title: A School Diary Entry
description: Practise the past simple, adverbs of frequency and sequencing words, then write a diary entry about a school day.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: We ___ a maths test this morning.
exercises.explanation: "This morning" is finished time, so use the past simple. "Have" is irregular: have - had.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: I ___ (forget) my lunch box at home.
exercises.explanation: "Forget" is irregular: forget - forgot.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.explanation: Use "in" with parts of the day: in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening (but at night).

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I am never late for school.
exercises.explanation: Adverbs of frequency go after the verb "be": I am never late.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: The test was more easier than last week's test.
answers: The test was easier than last week's test.
exercises.explanation: Easy - easier. Do not use "more" and -er together.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word.
exercises.text: First we had science. ___ that, we had a break.
exercises.explanation: "After that" shows the next event in time order.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I ___ to the teacher when the bell rang.
exercises.explanation: Past continuous = was/were + -ing for an action in progress. With "I" we use "was": I was listening.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: We ___ (stop) writing when the teacher came in.
exercises.explanation: Short verbs ending in one vowel + one consonant double the consonant before -ed: stop - stopped.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: Our teacher gave us a lot of homework.
exercises.explanation: Give + person + thing: Our teacher gave us a lot of homework. "Give" is irregular: give - gave.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We had too much tests this week.
answers: We had too many tests this week.
exercises.explanation: "Tests" is a plural countable noun, so we use "many", not "much".

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: Art is the ___ lesson of the week.
exercises.explanation: Long adjectives form the superlative with "the most": the most interesting.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with one preposition.
exercises.text: We have PE ___ Tuesdays and Thursdays.
exercises.explanation: We use "on" with days of the week: on Tuesdays, on Monday morning.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Past simple negative = didn't + base verb: I didn't finish (not "didn't finished").

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My friends was very kind to me today.
answers: My friends were very kind to me today.
exercises.explanation: With plural subjects we use "were" in the past: my friends were.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I think I ___ get a good mark in the test tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: We use "will" + base verb to make predictions about the future, often after "I think".

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with "some" or "any".
exercises.text: There weren't ___ chairs in the classroom, so we sat on the floor.
exercises.explanation: We use "any" in negative sentences: There weren't any chairs.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I am going to study harder.
Am I going to study harder?
exercises.explanation: Subject + am/is/are + going to + verb for a plan: I am going to study harder.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Our school day finishes on four o'clock.
answers: Our school day finishes at four o'clock.
exercises.explanation: We use "at" with clock times: at four o'clock, at 7.30.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I studied a lot, ___ the test was still difficult.
exercises.explanation: "But" joins two ideas that contrast: I studied a lot, but the test was difficult.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My handwriting is gooder than my brother's.
answers: My handwriting is better than my brother's.
exercises.explanation: "Good" has an irregular comparative: good - better - the best.

task.prompt: Write a diary entry about your day at school today.
contentPoints: Say what you are going to do tomorrow.
task.modelAnswer:
Tuesday, 3rd March

Dear Diary,

Today was a busy day at school. In the morning we had a maths test. It was easier than last week's test, so I was happy. After that, we had science and art. Then I had a problem: I forgot my lunch box at home! Luckily, my friend Lan shared her rice with me. Tomorrow I am going to bring a sandwich for her.
